summary: Pulse Biosciences, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement on August 6, 2026, for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $75 million of common stock through Mizuho Securities as sales agent. The offering is under a shelf registration (S-3) with a $200 million aggregate limit. No shares were sold at filing; sales will occur from time to time on Nasdaq at prevailing prices ($37.90 per share on August 5, 2026). Mizuho receives up to 3% commission. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation.
